name: claude-code-extras
description: Small, low-dependency, broadly applicable hooks and skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: timings
plugins.description: Gives Claude a sense of elapsed time: idle gaps, assistant turn duration split by tool vs model, and per-tool-call durations.

plugins.name: quota
plugins.description: Lets Claude see your Claude subscription usage: the 5-hour session window, the weekly windows and extra-usage credits, each as used% against elapsed%, so pace is visible rather than just the raw number.
